title: Sphaira
author: NaGaa95, ITotalJustice
details:
Sphaira is a modern homebrew menu and file-management environment.

It includes a homebrew launcher, file browser, game and application management, install support, MTP and FTP functionality, App Store integration, forwarder creation, theme support, and a wide range of utility features.

This package installs Sphaira to `sd:/switch/sphaira/sphaira.nro`.
changelog:
1.1.0

# Sphaira 1.1.0

### Switch 2 :
- Added Switch 2 support, running under kaiHEN.
  - Installing, forwarders, Games, Game Card, Appstore, Themezer, IRS, USB and MTP are not available on Switch 2.

### Switch :
- Added an optional warning for homebrew built for an older ABI.
- Added exporting the bins of Switch 2 (T2) game cards. ([#415](https://github.com/NaGaa95/sphaira/pull/415), @strongt1me)
- Added the NCA key generations of firmware 21 to 23. ([#422](https://github.com/NaGaa95/sphaira/pull/422), @dragonflylee)
- Added Hungarian and improved Italian translations. ([#437](https://github.com/NaGaa95/sphaira/pull/437), @Kobuhor; [#413](https://github.com/NaGaa95/sphaira/pull/413), @sgrontflix)
- Fixed emuMMC being detected as active when it is disabled. ([#434](https://github.com/NaGaa95/sphaira/pull/434), @strongt1me)
- Improved picking the language of game titles. ([#420](https://github.com/NaGaa95/sphaira/pull/420), @dragonflylee)
- Added compile flags to leave out optional features. ([#441](https://github.com/NaGaa95/sphaira/pull/441), @dragonflylee)
